description: Use this when you know the business and the person wants to see what it offers. Returns each service's name, description, length and price, any deposit, and how it is booked: bookVia assistant means a time can be held here, and bookVia website means the person books on the business's own page at bookingPageUrl. Filter with query or category, or pick a branch with locationId. Do not use for health or medical treatments: businesses that offer them are not on this server.
